what: Post-table grep -Fxc expects exactly one exact model_provider selector on login-home/config.toml after login-path external_prepare_codex_auth
scenario_or_breakage: copied-config.toml supplies two exact-match strip targets (top-level line 77 and nested [model_providers.other] line 83); login-path strip removes both, and assert_top_level_not_line already requires zero top-level matches. Only example model_provider = "openai-larch-env" survives inside multiline text, which grep -Fxc does not count. A count==1 assertion false-fails on correct strip behavior or pressures the implementer to retain a selector the plan also says must be absent
suggested_fix: Require grep -Fxc == 0 for exact model_provider = "openai-larch-env" and env_key = "OPENAI_API_KEY" on login-home/config.toml, or add a separate fixture with one deliberate non-stripped exact selector before expecting count 1
